newsitem.title: USA: Schwab files for $150 mln shelf debt.
newsitem.headline: Schwab files for $150 mln shelf debt.

text.p: Charles Schwab Corp on Thursday filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission for up to $150 million in debt securities.
When combined with previous registrations, the company will have up to $196 million in debt securities available for sale.

Net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, including working capital, investments in or extentions of credit to subsidiaries, capital expenditures, stock repurchases, repayment of debt, or possible acquisitions.
According to the filing, underwriters may include Morgan Stanley & Co, Goldman, Sachs & Co and Charles Schwab & Co Inc.
